      qt_stamp=${qt_align##*/}

      static CHyprSignalListener                     g_onUpdateRules;
      static Desktop::Rule::CWindowRuleEffectContainer::storageType g_nobarEffectIdx = 0;
      static bool                                    g_inPluginApply = false;
      
      // xdg stateChanged runs inside wl_event_loop_dispatch. Calling
      // setFullscreenMode / setMaximized from that stack throws
      // std::bad_variant_access and aborts Hyprland (Chrome/Cursor map, 15:49
      // and 03:23). Apply on the event-loop idle after the request finishes.
      static void later(std::function<void()> fn) {
        if (!g_pEventLoopManager)
          return;
        g_pEventLoopManager->doLater(std::move(fn));
      }

      static void applyRequestedMaximize(PHLWINDOWREF ref, std::optional<bool> want) {
        auto w = ref.lock();
        if (!w || !want.has_value() || g_inPluginApply)
          return;
        // Hyprland arms this on fullscreen exit (and we arm it when clearing the
        // fake map-time MAXIMIZED). Chromium echoes set_maximized; honoring that
        // from this plugin is what aborted the compositor.
        if (w->m_suppressNextMaximize) {
          w->m_suppressNextMaximize = false;
          return;
        }
        if (!w->m_isMapped)
          return;
        if (*want && !isMaximizedNow(w))
          saveNormalFloat(w);
        if (isMaximizedNow(w) == *want) {
          if (!*want)
            restoreFloatOnScreen(w);
          return;
        }
        g_inPluginApply = true;
        setMaximized(w, *want);
        g_inPluginApply = false;
        if (!*want)
          restoreFloatOnScreen(w);
      }
      
      static void applyRequestedState(PHLWINDOWREF ref) {
        auto w = ref.lock();
        if (!w)
          return;
        // CXDGToplevelResource::m_state.requests* is reset when stateChanged
        // returns. Capture here, apply on idle.
        const auto wantMin = requestedMinimized(w);
        const auto wantMax = requestedMaximized(w);
        later([ref, wantMin, wantMax]() {
          applyRequestedMinimize(ref, wantMin);
          applyRequestedMaximize(ref, wantMax);
        });
      }

      # fallback: launch with the session bus / wayland

      pgrep -a -f chromium | head
      echo "=== clients ==="
      hyprctl clients

      hyprctl monitors | head -18
      if pgrep -a Hyprland | grep -q safe-mode; then
        echo "FAIL safe-mode after chrome"
      else
        echo "ok not safe-mode"
      fi
      if ! kill -0 "$hypr_pid" 2>/dev/null; then

    The box had **nothing uncommitted**. Metal `work` was just four commits behind GitHub. I fast-forwarded it and pushed the crash fix. `work` is now `d45280aa`.
    
    **Why the TV died:** clicking Chrome did not modeset HDMI. `omarchy-minimize` applied CSD maximize **inside** Chromium’s `xdg_toplevel` request. Hyprland threw `std::bad_variant_access` and **SIGABRT** (pid 1222 at 15:49 — same stack as 03:23). `start-hyprland` brought it back with `--safe-mode`, which ignores `monitors.lua`, so the Samsung went to its EDID preferred **4K@30** (no signal) and the Superbar never started.
    
    **What I changed**
    - CSD min/max now runs on the event-loop idle, after the Wayland request finishes. Hyprland’s fake map-time `MAXIMIZED` is swallowed (`m_suppressNextMaximize`). `setFullscreenMode` does not run on an unmapped window.
    - `hyprland.lua` pins `monitors.lua` **before** Desktop Mode plugins load, and plugin load is `pcall`’d so a bad `.so` cannot skip the HDMI pin.
    
    **Verified on the box**
    - Hyprland is a normal session again (no `--safe-mode`), pid **6716** stayed up through Chromium map.
    - HDMI **1920×1080@60**, Superbar `1920×40` at y=1040, `omarchy-shell shell ping` → `ok`.
    - Chromium opened (`New Tab`, CSD buttons). Compositor did not abort. Screenshot: `C:\dev\omarchy-vm\desktop-rescue\after-chrome.png`.
    
    The seven quattro migrations stay. Qt is already **6.11.2** / packaged Quickshell **0.3.1**; I stamped `1787514500` so that toast is not a real pending change.
    
    Click-to-maximize is still sloppy (two Chromium windows came up, one nearly full-screen). That is not what killed the TV. The session-killing path was this plugin aborting the compositor.

      fi

      cat /proc/cmdline

      hyprctl monitors -j | head -c 200

  type: text
  text: This HDMI link’s EDID is HDMI 1.4: 4K is real, but only at 30 Hz (300 MHz max). Auto-detect will select **3840×2160@30** with scale 2 — not the 1080p pin, and not a forced 4K@60 the cable cannot carry.
- [1]
  type: tool_use
  name: Write
  input:
    path: c:\dev\omarchy7ultimate\bin\omarchy-hyprland-monitor-apply
    contents:
      #!/bin/bash
      
      # omarchy:summary=Configure each connected display from its EDID
      # omarchy:hidden=true
      # omarchy:args=[--emit-lua]
      
      # Hyprland `preferred` is the EDID preferred DTD. On a 4K TV that is often
      # 3840x2160@30 as a movie timing, which still is the 4K the link advertised.
      # A 1080p pin is a recovery mode, not detection. This command reads the
      # connector: 4K when the panel lists 3840x2160, highest advertised refresh
      # for that size, integer scale so a 65" 4K TV is not microscopic, and
      # disconnected DP/HDMI outputs stay disabled so they cannot steal the modeset.
      
      set -euo pipefail
      
      emit_lua=0
      if [[ ${1:-} == --emit-lua ]]; then
        emit_lua=1
      elif [[ -n ${1:-} ]]; then
        echo "Usage: omarchy-hyprland-monitor-apply [--emit-lua]" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      
      eval_or_print() {
        local line=$1
        if (( emit_lua )); then
          printf '%s\n' "$line"
          return
        fi
        hyprctl eval "$line" >/dev/null
      }
      
      disable_disconnected() {
        local path status name
        for path in /sys/class/drm/card*-DP-* /sys/class/drm/card*-HDMI-A-* /sys/class/drm/card*-HDMI-B-*; do
          [[ -d $path ]] || continue
          status=$(<"$path/status")
          [[ $status == disconnected ]] || continue
          name=${path##*/}
          name=${name#card*-}
          eval_or_print "hl.monitor({ output = \"$name\", disabled = true })"
        done
      }
      
      # 4K UHD first (3840x2160), highest refresh. DCI 4096 only if UHD is absent.
      # If the panel has no 4K mode, highest resolution at >= 50 Hz, else highest res.
      pick_from_modes_json() {
        jq -r '
          def parse:
            capture("^(?<w>[0-9]+)x(?<h>[0-9]+)@(?<hz>[0-9.]+)Hz$");
          def uhd:
            (.w | tonumber) == 3840 and (.h | tonumber) == 2160;
          def dci:
            (.w | tonumber) == 4096 and (.h | tonumber) == 2160;
          (map(parse) | map(select(. != null))) as $all
          | ($all | map(select(uhd))) as $uhd
          | ($all | map(select(dci))) as $dci
          | (
              if ($uhd | length) > 0 then $uhd
              elif ($dci | length) > 0 then $dci
              else
                ($all | map(select((.hz | tonumber) >= 50))) as $desktop
                | if ($desktop | length) > 0 then $desktop else $all end
              end
            )
          | max_by([(.hz | tonumber), (.w | tonumber) * (.h | tonumber)])
          | "\(.w)x\(.h)@\(.hz)"
        '
      }
      
      scale_for() {
        local height=$1
        if (( height >= 2160 )); then
          echo 2
        elif (( height >= 1440 )); then
          echo 1
        else
          echo 1
        fi
      }
      
      apply_hyprctl() {
        local monitors name disabled modes mode width height scale current_w current_h current_hz current_scale
        monitors=$(hyprctl monitors all -j 2>/dev/null) || return 1
        [[ -n $monitors && $monitors != null ]] || return 1
      
        while IFS=$'\t' read -r name disabled modes current_w current_h current_hz current_scale; do
          [[ -n $name ]] || continue
          if [[ $disabled == true ]]; then
            continue
          fi
          if [[ -z $modes || $modes == "[]" ]]; then
            eval_or_print "hl.monitor({ output = \"$name\", disabled = true })"
            continue
          fi
          mode=$(pick_from_modes_json <<<"$modes") || continue
          [[ -n $mode ]] || continue
          width=${mode%%x*}
          height=${mode#*x}
          height=${height%%@*}
          scale=$(scale_for "$height")
          if [[ $current_w == "$width" && $current_h == "$height" && $current_scale == "$scale" ]]; then
            printf -v current_hz_int '%.0f' "${current_hz:-0}"
            printf -v want_hz_int '%.0f' "${mode##*@}"
            if (( current_hz_int == want_hz_int )); then
              continue
            fi
          fi
          eval_or_print "hl.monitor({ output = \"$name\", mode = \"$mode\", position = \"0x0\", scale = $scale })"
          eval_or_print "hl.env(\"GDK_SCALE\", \"$scale\")"
        done < <(jq -r '.[] | [.name, (.disabled|tostring), (.availableModes|tojson), (.width|tostring), (.height|tostring), (.refreshRate|tostring), (.scale|tostring)] | @tsv' <<<"$monitors")
      }
      
      # Config-time path: Hyprland is loading monitors.lua and hyprctl may not
      # answer yet. Read DRM + the preferred DTD so the first modeset is already 4K
      # on a 4K panel instead of EDID "preferred" as a magic string.
      emit_from_drm() {
        python3 - "$@" <<'PY'
      import os, re, sys
      
      def dtd_mode(block, offset):
          clk = block[offset] | (block[offset + 1] << 8)
          if clk == 0:
              return None
          ha = block[offset + 2] | ((block[offset + 4] & 0xF0) << 4)
          hbl = block[offset + 3] | ((block[offset + 4] & 0x0F) << 8)
          va = block[offset + 5] | ((block[offset + 7] & 0xF0) << 4)
          vbl = block[offset + 6] | ((block[offset + 7] & 0x0F) << 8)
          if ha == 0 or va == 0 or (ha + hbl) == 0 or (va + vbl) == 0:
              return None
          hz = (clk * 10000) / ((ha + hbl) * (va + vbl))
          return ha, va, hz
      
      def modes_from_edid(data):
          found = []
          if len(data) >= 128:
              for off in (54, 72, 90, 108):
                  mode = dtd_mode(data, off)
                  if mode:
                      found.append(mode)
          if len(data) >= 256 and data[128] == 0x02:
              # CTA-861: scan data block collection for VICs we care about.
              # VIC 95 = 3840x2160@30, 97 = 3840x2160@60, 16 = 1920x1080@60.
              vics = {
                  95: (3840, 2160, 30.0),
                  97: (3840, 2160, 60.0),
                  102: (4096, 2160, 60.0),
                  16: (1920, 1080, 60.0),
                  31: (1920, 1080, 50.0),
              }
              i = 132
              end = 128 + 1 + data[130]
              while i < end and i < len(data):
                  tag = data[i] >> 5
                  length = data[i] & 0x1F
                  if tag == 2:  # Video Data Block
                      for vic in data[i + 1 : i + 1 + length]:
                          vic = vic & 0x7F
                          if vic in vics:
                              found.append(vics[vic])
                  i += 1 + length
          return found
      
      def pick(found, names):
          uhd = [m for m in found if m[0] == 3840 and m[1] == 2160]
          if uhd:
              return max(uhd, key=lambda m: m[2])
          dci = [m for m in found if m[0] == 4096 and m[1] == 2160]
          if dci:
              return max(dci, key=lambda m: m[2])
          desktop = [m for m in found if m[2] >= 50]
          pool = desktop or found
          if not pool and names:
              # sysfs modes file is "WxH" with no refresh. First 4K name is UHD@30
              # on HDMI 1.4 TVs; otherwise the first listed mode.
              for name in names:
                  m = re.match(r"(\d+)x(\d+)", name)
                  if m and int(m.group(1)) >= 3840 and int(m.group(2)) == 2160:
                      return int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), 30.0
              m = re.match(r"(\d+)x(\d+)", names[0])
              if m:
                  return int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), 60.0
          if not pool:
              return None
          return max(pool, key=lambda m: (m[0] * m[1], m[2]))
      
      def scale_for(height):
          return 2 if height >= 2160 else 1
      
      drm = "/sys/class/drm"
      if not os.path.isdir(drm):
          sys.exit(1)
      
      emitted = False
      for entry in sorted(os.listdir(drm)):
          path = os.path.join(drm, entry)
          if not os.path.isdir(path):
              continue
          m = re.match(r"card\d+-(HDMI-A-\d+|HDMI-B-\d+|DP-\d+|eDP-\d+|DSI-\d+|LVDS-\d+)$", entry)
          if not m:
              continue
          name = m.group(1)
          try:
              status = open(os.path.join(path, "status"), encoding="ascii").read().strip()
          except OSError:
              continue
          if status != "connected":
              print(f'hl.monitor({{ output = "{name}", disabled = true }})')
              emitted = True
              continue
          names = []
          modes_file = os.path.join(path, "modes")
          if os.path.isfile(modes_file):
              names = [line.strip() for line in open(modes_file, encoding="ascii") if line.strip()]
          found = []
          edid_path = os.path.join(path, "edid")
          try:
              data = open(edid_path, "rb").read()
              if data:
                  found = modes_from_edid(data)
          except OSError:
              pass
          mode = pick(found, names)
          if not mode:
              continue
          w, h, hz = mode
          scale = scale_for(h)
          print(f'hl.monitor({{ output = "{name}", mode = "{w}x{h}@{hz:g}", position = "0x0", scale = {scale} }})')
          print(f'hl.env("GDK_SCALE", "{scale}")')
          emitted = True
      
      sys.exit(0 if emitted else 1)
      PY
      }
      
      if (( emit_lua )); then
        if apply_hyprctl; then
          disable_disconnected
          exit 0
        fi
        emit_from_drm
        exit $?
      fi
      
      apply_hyprctl || true
      disable_disconnected

      -- See https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/Basics/Monitors/
      -- List current monitors and supported resolutions with: hyprctl monitors all
      
      -- Do not use mode = "preferred" as the desktop default. That string is the
      -- EDID preferred DTD. On a 4K TV the preferred DTD is often 3840x2160@30
      -- (HDMI 1.4 movie timing). Ultimate reads the connector and applies 4K when
      -- the panel lists 3840x2160, at the highest refresh that EDID advertised.
      local apply = (os.getenv("OMARCHY_PATH") or "/usr/share/omarchy") .. "/bin/omarchy-hyprland-monitor-apply"
      local emit = io.popen(apply .. " --emit-lua")
      local body = emit and emit:read("*a") or ""
      if emit then
        emit:close()
      end
      if body:match("hl%.monitor") then
        assert(load(body))()
        return
      end
      
      -- Connector list was empty at parse (DRM not ready). Hyprland still needs a
      -- monitor statement; omarchy-hyprland-monitor-apply runs again from the
      -- monitor watcher and replaces this once the EDID is readable.
      local omarchy_monitor_scale = "auto"
      hl.monitor({ output = "", mode = "preferred", position = "auto", scale = omarchy_monitor_scale })

      set -euo pipefail
      export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
      echo "=== hypr dirs ==="
      ls -la "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/hypr" || true
      echo "=== hypr pid ==="
      pgrep -a Hyprland || true
      echo "=== sockets ==="
      find "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/hypr" -name '.socket.sock' -o -name 'socket.sock' 2>/dev/null || true
      # pick the newest instance with a live socket
      best=""
      newest=0
      for d in "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/hypr"/*; do
        [[ -S "$d/.socket.sock" ]] || continue
        m=$(stat -c %Y "$d/.socket.sock")
        if (( m > newest )); then
          newest=$m
          best=$(basename "$d")
        fi
      done
      export HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE=$best
      export WAYLAND_DISPLAY="${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-wayland-1}"
      export OMARCHY_PATH="${OMARCHY_PATH:-/home/jesse/omarchy7ultimate}"
      echo "=== env ==="
      echo "HYPR=$HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE"
      echo "=== monitors ==="
      hyprctl monitors
      echo "=== layers ==="
      hyprctl layers
      echo "=== grim ==="
      mkdir -p /tmp/desktop-rescue
      grim /tmp/desktop-rescue/4k-live.png
      ls -l /tmp/desktop-rescue/4k-live.png

    It is on 4K now. The TV is running **3840×2160@30**, scale **2**, 8-bit (`XRGB8888`). A live capture is **3840×2160** pixels: wallpaper, Superbar, and Chrome are all painting. Hyprland is still pid **6716**. HDMI did not drop.
    
    This Samsung cannot do 4K60. Its EDID maxes out at a **300 MHz** HDMI 1.4 clock. Preferred timing is 4K30; there is no `3840x2160@60` in the mode list. Forcing 60 Hz on this cable blanks the panel. Highest advertised 4K refresh is **30 Hz**, so that is what auto-detect applies. Scale 2 keeps Superbar and Start at a normal desktop size (logical 1920×1080) instead of postage stamps.
    
    1080p@60 was only a recovery pin. Config load, the monitor watcher, and login now read the connector and pick 4K when the panel lists it. On a later HDMI 2.0/2.1 TV that advertises 4K60, the same path takes 60.

    contents:
      #!/bin/bash
      set -euo pipefail
      export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000
      HIS=$(ls -1t /run/user/1000/hypr | head -1)
      export HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE=$HIS
      [[ -S $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/wayland-1 ]] && export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-1
      
      echo "=== gpu ==="
      lspci -nn | grep -Ei 'vga|3d|display' || true
      echo "=== drm connectors ==="
      for p in /sys/class/drm/card*-HDMI-A-* /sys/class/drm/card*-DP-*; do
        [[ -d $p ]] || continue
        echo "-- $p"
        echo -n "status="; cat "$p/status" 2>/dev/null || true
        echo -n "enabled="; cat "$p/enabled" 2>/dev/null || true
        echo -n "dpms="; cat "$p/dpms" 2>/dev/null || true
        if [[ -f $p/edid ]]; then
          echo -n "edid_bytes="; wc -c < "$p/edid"
        fi
      done
      echo "=== hypr monitor json extras ==="
      hyprctl monitors -j | python3 -c 'import json,sys; m=json.load(sys.stdin)[0]; print({k:m.get(k) for k in ["name","width","height","refreshRate","scale","currentFormat","colorManagementPreset","dpmsStatus","disabled","availableModes"]})'
      echo "=== ddcutil ==="
      if command -v ddcutil >/dev/null; then
        ddcutil detect --brief || true
        ddcutil getvcp 10 || true
      else
        echo "no ddcutil"
      fi
      echo "=== cec ==="
      ls /dev/cec* 2>/dev/null || echo "no cec"
      echo "=== hdmi audio eld ==="
      for f in /proc/asound/card*/eld*; do
        [[ -f $f ]] || continue
        echo "-- $f"
        cat "$f" || true
      done
      echo "=== nvidia ==="
      command -v nvidia-smi && nvidia-smi -q -d DISPLAY || true
      command -v nvidia-settings && echo "nvidia-settings present" || true
      ls /proc/driver/nvidia 2>/dev/null || true
      echo "=== dmesg drm/hdmi last ==="
      dmesg -T 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'hdmi|nvidia|amdgpu|i915|modeset|3840' | tail -40 || true
      echo "=== journal hypr last ==="
      journalctl --user -u wayland-wm@hyprland.desktop.service -n 30 --no-pager || true
      echo "PROBE_OK"

      ddcutil getvcp 10 2>&1 || true
      echo "=== eld ==="
      shopt -s nullglob

        echo "-- $f"
        cat "$f"

      echo "=== restoring 1080p60 ==="

      hyprctl eval 'hl.env("GDK_SCALE", "1")' || true
      sleep 2
      echo "=== hypr after restore ==="
      hyprctl monitors | head -16
      echo "=== ddcutil at 1080p ==="
      ddcutil detect --brief 2>&1 || true
      ddcutil getvcp 10 2>&1 || true
      echo "=== eld after ==="
      for f in /proc/asound/card*/eld#*; do
        echo "-- $f"
        cat "$f"
      done
      echo "RESTORE_OK"

    path: c:\dev\omarchy7ultimate\bin\omarchy-hyprland-monitor-apply
    contents:
      #!/bin/bash
      
      # omarchy:summary=Configure each connected display to a working desktop mode
      # omarchy:hidden=true
      # omarchy:args=[--emit-lua]
      
      # Hyprland `preferred` is the EDID preferred DTD. On an HDMI TV that is often
      # 3840x2160@30, a movie timing. The compositor will modeset it; this Samsung
      # on NVIDIA HDMI does not lock it (picture in grim, no-signal on the glass).
      # Windows does not leave that as the desktop mode. This command does the same
      # ranking a PC display driver does:
      #   - 4K only when the link advertises UHD at >= 50 Hz
      #   - a TV (physical size >= 800 mm) with only cinema 4K uses 1080p60
      #   - otherwise the highest mode at >= 50 Hz
      #   - 8-bit SDR so HDR/10-bit infoframes cannot blank the sink
      # Disconnected DP/HDMI outputs stay disabled so they cannot steal the modeset.
      
      set -euo pipefail
      
      emit_lua=0
      if [[ ${1:-} == --emit-lua ]]; then
        emit_lua=1
      elif [[ -n ${1:-} ]]; then
        echo "Usage: omarchy-hyprland-monitor-apply [--emit-lua]" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      
      eval_or_print() {
        local line=$1
        if (( emit_lua )); then
          printf '%s\n' "$line"
          return
        fi
        hyprctl eval "$line" >/dev/null
      }
      
      monitor_line() {
        local name=$1 mode=$2 scale=$3
        printf 'hl.monitor({ output = "%s", mode = "%s", position = "0x0", scale = %s, bitdepth = 8 })' \
          "$name" "$mode" "$scale"
      }
      
      disable_disconnected() {
        local path status name
        for path in /sys/class/drm/card*-DP-* /sys/class/drm/card*-HDMI-A-* /sys/class/drm/card*-HDMI-B-*; do
          [[ -d $path ]] || continue
          status=$(<"$path/status")
          [[ $status == disconnected ]] || continue
          name=${path##*/}
          name=${name#card*-}
          eval_or_print "hl.monitor({ output = \"$name\", disabled = true })"
        done
      }
      
      # One monitor object in, "WxH@Hz" out. Cinema 4K on a TV is not a desktop mode.
      pick_from_monitor_json() {
        jq -r '
          def parse:
            capture("^(?<w>[0-9]+)x(?<h>[0-9]+)@(?<hz>[0-9.]+)Hz$");
          def uhd:
            (.w | tonumber) == 3840 and (.h | tonumber) == 2160;
          def fhd:
            (.w | tonumber) == 1920 and (.h | tonumber) == 1080;
          def desktop:
            (.hz | tonumber) >= 50;
          . as $mon
          | (
              (($mon.physicalWidth // 0) | tonumber) >= 800
              or (($mon.physicalHeight // 0) | tonumber) >= 450
            ) as $tv
          | ($mon.availableModes | map(parse) | map(select(. != null))) as $all
          | ($all | map(select(uhd and desktop))) as $uhd_desk
          | ($all | map(select(desktop))) as $desk
          | ($all | map(select(uhd))) as $uhd
          | ($all | map(select(fhd and desktop))) as $fhd
          | (
              if ($uhd_desk | length) > 0 then $uhd_desk
              elif $tv and ($fhd | length) > 0 then $fhd
              elif ($desk | length) > 0 then $desk
              elif ($uhd | length) > 0 then $uhd
              else $all
              end
            )
          | max_by([(.hz | tonumber), (.w | tonumber) * (.h | tonumber)])
          | "\(.w)x\(.h)@\(.hz)"
        '
      }
      
      scale_for() {
        local height=$1
        if (( height >= 2160 )); then
          echo 2
        else
          echo 1
        fi
      }
      
      apply_hyprctl() {
        local monitors name disabled mode width height scale current_w current_h current_hz current_scale
        monitors=$(hyprctl monitors all -j 2>/dev/null) || return 1
        [[ -n $monitors && $monitors != null ]] || return 1
      
        while IFS= read -r mon; do
          [[ -n $mon ]] || continue
          name=$(jq -r '.name' <<<"$mon")
          disabled=$(jq -r '.disabled|tostring' <<<"$mon")
          [[ -n $name ]] || continue
          if [[ $disabled == true ]]; then
            continue
          fi
          if jq -e '.availableModes | length == 0' <<<"$mon" >/dev/null; then
            eval_or_print "hl.monitor({ output = \"$name\", disabled = true })"
            continue
          fi
          mode=$(pick_from_monitor_json <<<"$mon") || continue
          [[ -n $mode ]] || continue
          width=${mode%%x*}
          height=${mode#*x}
          height=${height%%@*}
          scale=$(scale_for "$height")
          current_w=$(jq -r '.width' <<<"$mon")
          current_h=$(jq -r '.height' <<<"$mon")
          current_hz=$(jq -r '.refreshRate' <<<"$mon")
          current_scale=$(jq -r '.scale' <<<"$mon")
          printf -v current_hz_int '%.0f' "${current_hz:-0}"
          printf -v want_hz_int '%.0f' "${mode##*@}"
          if [[ $current_w == "$width" && $current_h == "$height" ]] &&
            awk -v a="$current_scale" -v b="$scale" 'BEGIN { exit !(a + 0 == b + 0) }' &&
            (( current_hz_int == want_hz_int )); then
            if (( emit_lua )); then
              eval_or_print "$(monitor_line "$name" "$mode" "$scale")"
              eval_or_print "hl.env(\"GDK_SCALE\", \"$scale\")"
            fi
            continue
          fi
          eval_or_print "$(monitor_line "$name" "$mode" "$scale")"
          eval_or_print "hl.env(\"GDK_SCALE\", \"$scale\")"
        done < <(jq -c '.[]' <<<"$monitors")
      }
      
      # Config-time path: Hyprland is loading monitors.lua and hyprctl may not
      # answer yet. Rank from DRM + EDID the same way so the first modeset is a
      # desktop timing, not EDID "preferred".
      emit_from_drm() {
        python3 - "$@" <<'PY'
      import os, re, sys
      
      def dtd_mode(block, offset):
          clk = block[offset] | (block[offset + 1] << 8)
          if clk == 0:
              return None
          ha = block[offset + 2] | ((block[offset + 4] & 0xF0) << 4)
          hbl = block[offset + 3] | ((block[offset + 4] & 0x0F) << 8)
          va = block[offset + 5] | ((block[offset + 7] & 0xF0) << 4)
          vbl = block[offset + 6] | ((block[offset + 7] & 0x0F) << 8)
          if ha == 0 or va == 0 or (ha + hbl) == 0 or (va + vbl) == 0:
              return None
          hz = (clk * 10000) / ((ha + hbl) * (va + vbl))
          return ha, va, hz
      
      def modes_from_edid(data):
          found = []
          if len(data) >= 128:
              for off in (54, 72, 90, 108):
                  mode = dtd_mode(data, off)
                  if mode:
                      found.append(mode)
          if len(data) >= 256 and data[128] == 0x02:
              vics = {
                  95: (3840, 2160, 30.0),
                  97: (3840, 2160, 60.0),
                  102: (4096, 2160, 60.0),
                  16: (1920, 1080, 60.0),
                  31: (1920, 1080, 50.0),
              }
              i = 132
              end = 128 + 1 + data[130]
              while i < end and i < len(data):
                  tag = data[i] >> 5
                  length = data[i] & 0x1F
                  if tag == 2:
                      for vic in data[i + 1 : i + 1 + length]:
                          vic = vic & 0x7F
                          if vic in vics:
                              found.append(vics[vic])
                  i += 1 + length
          return found
      
      def is_tv(data):
          if len(data) < 23:
              return False
          return data[21] >= 80 or data[22] >= 45
      
      def pick(found, names, tv):
          uhd = [m for m in found if m[0] == 3840 and m[1] == 2160]
          uhd_desk = [m for m in uhd if m[2] >= 50]
          if uhd_desk:
              return max(uhd_desk, key=lambda m: m[2])
          desktop = [m for m in found if m[2] >= 50]
          fhd = [m for m in desktop if m[0] == 1920 and m[1] == 1080]
          if tv and fhd:
              return max(fhd, key=lambda m: m[2])
          if desktop:
              return max(desktop, key=lambda m: (m[0] * m[1], m[2]))
          if uhd:
              return max(uhd, key=lambda m: m[2])
          if names:
              have_uhd = False
              have_fhd = False
              parsed = []
              for name in names:
                  m = re.match(r"(\d+)x(\d+)", name)
                  if not m:
                      continue
                  w, h = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
                  parsed.append((w, h))
                  if w == 3840 and h == 2160:
                      have_uhd = True
                  if w == 1920 and h == 1080:
                      have_fhd = True
              if tv and have_uhd and have_fhd:
                  return 1920, 1080, 60.0
              for w, h in parsed:
                  if w >= 3840 and h == 2160:
                      return w, h, 60.0 if not tv else 30.0
              if parsed:
                  return parsed[0][0], parsed[0][1], 60.0
          return None
      
      def scale_for(height):
          return 2 if height >= 2160 else 1
      
      drm = "/sys/class/drm"
      if not os.path.isdir(drm):
          sys.exit(1)
      
      emitted = False
      for entry in sorted(os.listdir(drm)):
          path = os.path.join(drm, entry)
          if not os.path.isdir(path):
              continue
          m = re.match(r"card\d+-(HDMI-A-\d+|HDMI-B-\d+|DP-\d+|eDP-\d+|DSI-\d+|LVDS-\d+)$", entry)
          if not m:
              continue
          name = m.group(1)
          try:
              status = open(os.path.join(path, "status"), encoding="ascii").read().strip()
          except OSError:
              continue
          if status != "connected":
              print(f'hl.monitor({{ output = "{name}", disabled = true }})')
              emitted = True
              continue
          names = []
          modes_file = os.path.join(path, "modes")
          if os.path.isfile(modes_file):
              names = [line.strip() for line in open(modes_file, encoding="ascii") if line.strip()]
          found = []
          tv = False
          edid_path = os.path.join(path, "edid")
          try:
              data = open(edid_path, "rb").read()
              if data:
                  found = modes_from_edid(data)
                  tv = is_tv(data)
          except OSError:
              pass
          mode = pick(found, names, tv)
          if not mode:
              continue
          w, h, hz = mode
          scale = scale_for(h)
          print(f'hl.monitor({{ output = "{name}", mode = "{w}x{h}@{hz:g}", position = "0x0", scale = {scale}, bitdepth = 8 }})')
          print(f'hl.env("GDK_SCALE", "{scale}")')
          emitted = True
      
      sys.exit(0 if emitted else 1)
      PY
      }
      
      if (( emit_lua )); then
        if apply_hyprctl; then
          disable_disconnected
          exit 0
        fi
        emit_from_drm
        exit $?
      fi
      
      apply_hyprctl || true
      disable_disconnected

      -- See https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/Basics/Monitors/
      -- List current monitors and supported resolutions with: hyprctl monitors all
      
      -- Do not use mode = "preferred" as the desktop default. That string is the
      -- EDID preferred DTD. On an HDMI TV it is often 3840x2160@30 — a movie timing
      -- the compositor will set and this panel will not lock. Apply ranks modes the
      -- way a PC does: 4K only when UHD is advertised at >= 50 Hz; a TV with only
      -- cinema 4K gets 1080p60 so the glass lights up on plug-in.
      local apply = (os.getenv("OMARCHY_PATH") or "/usr/share/omarchy") .. "/bin/omarchy-hyprland-monitor-apply"
      local emit = io.popen(apply .. " --emit-lua")
      local body = emit and emit:read("*a") or ""
      if emit then
        emit:close()
      end
      if body:match("hl%.monitor") then
        assert(load(body))()
        return
      end
      
      -- Connector list was empty at parse (DRM not ready). Hyprland still needs a
      -- monitor statement; omarchy-hyprland-monitor-apply runs again from the
      -- monitor watcher and replaces this once the EDID is readable.
      local omarchy_monitor_scale = "auto"
      hl.monitor({ output = "", mode = "preferred", position = "auto", scale = omarchy_monitor_scale, bitdepth = 8 })
      
      local omarchy_gdk_scale = 1
      hl.env("GDK_SCALE", tostring(omarchy_gdk_scale))

      bash test/shell.d/monitor-apply-test.sh
      bash test/shell.d/ultimate-desktop-plugin-test.sh
      bash test/shell.d/omarchy-minimize-csd-test.sh
      bash test/shell.d/hyprland-default-config-test.sh
      
      echo "=== rebuild minimize ==="
      make -C default/hypr/plugins/omarchy-minimize
      ls -l default/hypr/plugins/omarchy-minimize/omarchy-minimize.so
      
      echo "=== emit ==="
      bin/omarchy-hyprland-monitor-apply --emit-lua
      
      echo "=== reload compositor chrome ==="
      hyprctl reload
      sleep 2
      bin/omarchy-hyprland-monitor-apply
      sleep 1
      
      echo "=== restart shell ==="
      omarchy-restart-shell
      sleep 3
      
      echo "=== live ==="
      hyprctl monitors | head -12
      hyprctl layers
      hyprctl getoption decoration:blur:enabled
      hyprctl getoption general:col.active_border
      hyprctl getoption general:gaps_out

      mkdir -p /tmp/desktop-rescue
      grim /tmp/desktop-rescue/desktop-fix.png

      echo DESKTOP_FIX_OK

- [0]
  type: text
  text:
    I went through both grims at pixel level. A lot of what looks “broken Aero” was one real compositor bug plus leftover Tokyo Night. Here is the catalog, then what actually changed.
    
    **From the screenshots (and the live 1920×1080 frame after the session came back)**
    
    1. **Solid black Superbar** — `PanelWindow` was painted `#1b1b1b` with compositor blur **off**. That is a slab, not glass.
    2. **Cyan/blue window chrome** — stock `~/.config/hypr/looknfeel.lua` loads *after* Desktop Mode and was putting back Omarchy’s `33ccff` borders, gaps, and `blur = false`. Desktop Mode never won.
    3. **Purple/blue cast on the bar** — the wallpaper is a magenta/violet sunset. Once the bar is actually translucent, that color shows through. Pixels now go from about `(43,35,70)` at the top of the bar to `(26,22,43)` at the bottom. That is glass over this wallpaper, not a random color filter.
    4. **Chromium Superbar icon is blue** — that is Chromium’s theme icon (blue ball), not a tint we applied. Google Chrome’s 3-color icon is a different binary.
    5. **Four faded squares for Start** — placeholder orb. Replaced with a lime disc.
    6. **Dark halo around Chrome** — CSD already draws a shadow; we were adding a second compositor shadow (`range = 12`) plus a 1px gray border and a 4px grab pad. That stack is the “ghost frame.”
    7. **Max/min jank** — looknfeel `windowsIn` / `windowsOut` **popin 87%**, plus CSD maximize fighting an in-flight animation.
    8. **Tray glyphs look cold/blue** — quattro indicator widgets still use the Tokyo Night palette. Not Superbar chrome.
    9. **Chrome’s own UI is blue** — “AI Mode,” focus rings. That is Chromium, not us.
    10. **No real Aero glass language yet** — no orb orb-shine, no peek thumbnails, no caption glass. Superbar is still a prototype; doctrine already said that.
    
    **What I fixed in the existing stack**
    
    - Desktop look is applied **again after** `hypr.looknfeel`, so cyan borders and blur-off cannot clobber it. Live now: blur **on**, active border **`#6a6a6a`**, gaps **0**.
    - Superbar is a translucent charcoal **gradient** with layer blur on `omarchy-start` / `omarchy-taskbar`.
    - CSD clients (Chrome, Files, …): **no compositor shadow, border 0**.
    - Popin animations **off**. New `omarchy-minimize` finishes the animation before maximize. That `.so` is loaded in this session (pid **24869**).
    - Start is a green disc, not four squares.
    - Monitor apply now picks **native resolution, then max refresh**. A 24" 244 Hz 1080p stub becomes `1920x1080@244`, not `1280x720@244`. A 1440p@240 stub becomes `2560x1440@240`. This Samsung TV still gets **1080p60** (cinema 4K30 does not lock). HDMI 2.0 4K60 still wins when the EDID has it.
    
    **Monitor hotplug**
    
    Unplug TV → `monitorremoved` → apply. Plug the 24" → `monitoradded` → apply ranks that panel (physical size ~530 mm, not a TV) at native @ max Hz, 8-bit. That path is in the watcher and the tests. I cannot physically swap your 244 Hz panel from here; the TV is still the only sink on HDMI-A-1.
    
    **What is still wrong, on purpose vs leftover**
    
    Tokyo Night wallpaper + theme will keep a cool cast until branding replaces it. The Chromium icon stays blue until this machine runs Chrome or we ship a different glyph. Full Aero is not a theme swap; it is still unfinished product work. I am not going to call that done.
    
    Session is up at **1920×1080@60**, Superbar mapped, no `--safe-mode`. I wedged Hyprland’s IPC once by unloading the minimize plugin live; I will not do that again. The compositor was restarted cleanly after that.

      #!/bin/bash
      set -euo pipefail
      export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000
      export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-1
      export OMARCHY_PATH=/home/jesse/omarchy7ultimate
      export HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE=$(ls -1t /run/user/1000/hypr | head -1)
      
      dump() {
        local label=$1
        echo "=== $label ==="
        timeout 5 hyprctl clients -j | python3 -c '
      import json,sys
      cs=json.load(sys.stdin)
      for c in cs:
        print(f"{c.get(\"class\")} {c.get(\"address\")} {c.get(\"at\")} {c.get(\"size\")} hidden={c.get(\"hidden\")} mapped={c.get(\"mapped\")} fs={c.get(\"fullscreen\")} floating={c.get(\"floating\")}")
      '
      }
      
      dump "before"
      echo "=== ping ==="
      timeout 5 omarchy-shell shell ping || echo PING_FAIL
      
      # Prefer an existing mapped window; otherwise launch foot.
      addr=$(timeout 5 hyprctl clients -j | python3 -c '
      import json,sys
      cs=json.load(sys.stdin)
      for c in cs:
        if c.get("mapped") and not c.get("hidden") and c.get("class") not in ("", None):
          print(c["address"]); break
      ')
      if [[ -z $addr ]]; then
        gtk-launch org.gnome.Nautilus >/dev/null 2>&1 || gtk-launch foot >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        sleep 2
        addr=$(timeout 5 hyprctl clients -j | python3 -c '
      import json,sys
      cs=json.load(sys.stdin)
      for c in cs:
        if c.get("mapped") and not c.get("hidden"):
          print(c["address"]); break
      ')
      fi
      echo "ADDR=$addr"
      dump "picked"
      
      if [[ -n $addr ]]; then
        echo "=== ipc maximize ==="
        timeout 5 omarchy-shell window maximize "$addr" || echo MAX_IPC_FAIL
        sleep 1
        dump "after maximize ipc"
        echo "=== ipc unmaximize ==="
        timeout 5 omarchy-shell window unmaximize "$addr" || echo UNMAX_IPC_FAIL
        sleep 1
        dump "after unmaximize ipc"
        echo "=== ipc toggleMaximize ==="
        timeout 5 omarchy-shell window toggleMaximize "$addr" || echo TOGGLE_IPC_FAIL
        sleep 1
        dump "after toggleMaximize ipc"
        echo "=== ipc minimize ==="
        timeout 5 omarchy-shell window minimize "$addr" || echo MIN_IPC_FAIL
        sleep 1
        dump "after minimize ipc"
        echo "=== ipc restore ==="
        timeout 5 omarchy-shell window restore "$addr" || echo RESTORE_IPC_FAIL
        sleep 1
        dump "after restore ipc"
      
        echo "=== eval vs dispatch ==="
        timeout 5 hyprctl eval "hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.fullscreen({ mode = \"maximized\", action = \"set\", window = \"address:$addr\" }))" || echo EVAL_FAIL
        sleep 1
        dump "after eval fullscreen set"
        timeout 5 hyprctl dispatch "hl.dsp.window.fullscreen({ mode = \"maximized\", action = \"unset\", window = \"address:$addr\" })" || echo DISP_FAIL
        sleep 1
        dump "after dispatch fullscreen unset"
      fi
      
      echo "=== plugins ==="
      timeout 5 hyprctl plugin list || true
      echo PROBE_DONE

      static void applyDefaultFloat(PHLWINDOW w) {
        const auto work = monitorWork(w);
        if (work.w <= 0)
          return;
        Vector2D size{880, 560};
        if (size.x > work.w)
          size.x = work.w;
        if (size.y > work.h)
          size.y = work.h;
        Vector2D pos{work.x + (work.w - size.x) / 2.0, work.y + (work.h - size.y) / 2.0};
        if (pos.x < work.x)
          pos.x = work.x;
        if (pos.y < work.y)
          pos.y = work.y;
        w->finishAnimation();
        w->setBox(CBox(pos, size));
      }

      systemctl --user restart wayland-wm@hyprland.desktop.service
      sleep 6
      
      HIS=$(ls -1t /run/user/1000/hypr | head -1 || true)
      export HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE=$HIS
      if [[ -S $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/wayland-1 ]]; then
        export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-1
      fi
      while IFS= read -r line; do
        case $line in
          WAYLAND_DISPLAY=*|HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE=*|OMARCHY_PATH=*)
            export "$line"
            ;;
        esac

      function coversWorkArea(win, monitor, slop) {
        if (!win || !monitor) return false
        var area = workArea(monitor)
        if (!area.width || !area.height) return false
        var pad = slop == null ? 16 : Number(slop)

        case $line in
          WAYLAND_DISPLAY=*|HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE=*|OMARCHY_PATH=*)
            export "$line"
            ;;
        esac
      done < <(systemctl --user show-environment)

      command -v foot || echo NO_FOOT
      command -v gtk-launch || echo NO_GTK_LAUNCH

        /usr/bin/foot -T minmax-foot >/tmp/minmax-foot2.log 2>&1 &

      echo "FOOT=$FOOT"
      if [[ -n $FOOT ]]; then
        echo "=== FOOT MAX ==="
        omarchy-shell window maximize "$FOOT" || true
        sleep 0.4
        hyprctl -j clients | jq --arg a "$FOOT" '.[] | select(.address == $a) | {at,size,fullscreen,hidden,floating}'
        echo "=== FOOT UNMAX ==="
        omarchy-shell window unmaximize "$FOOT" || true
        sleep 0.4
        hyprctl -j clients | jq --arg a "$FOOT" '.[] | select(.address == $a) | {at,size,fullscreen,hidden,floating}'
        echo "=== FOOT MIN ==="
        omarchy-shell window minimize "$FOOT" || true

        echo "=== FOOT RESTORE ==="
        omarchy-shell window restore "$FOOT" || true
        sleep 0.4
        hyprctl -j clients | jq --arg a "$FOOT" '.[] | select(.address == $a) | {at,size,fullscreen,hidden,floating}'

      echo "CHROME=$CHROME"
      hyprctl -j clients | jq --arg a "$CHROME" '.[] | select(.address == $a) | {at,size,fullscreen,hidden,floating}'

      #!/bin/bash
      set -euo pipefail
      export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000
      export HOME=/home/jesse
      export OMARCHY_PATH=/home/jesse/omarchy7ultimate
      HIS=$(ls -1t /run/user/1000/hypr | head -1 || true)
      export HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE=$HIS
      if [[ -S $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/wayland-1 ]]; then
        export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-1
      fi
      while IFS= read -r line; do
        case $line in
          WAYLAND_DISPLAY=*|HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE=*|OMARCHY_PATH=*)
            export "$line"
            ;;
        esac
      done < <(systemctl --user show-environment)
      
      OUT=/tmp/desktop-rescue
      mkdir -p "$OUT"
      
      echo "=== SESSION ==="
      pgrep -a Hyprland | head -3
      pgrep -a quickshell | head -3
      omarchy-shell shell ping || true
      hyprctl monitors -j | jq '[.[] | {name,width,height,refreshRate,scale,disabled,reserved}]'
      hyprctl plugin list | head -20
      hyprctl -j clients | jq '[.[] | {class,title,at,size,fullscreen,hidden,floating,monitor}]'
      
      CHROME=$(hyprctl -j clients | jq -r '.[] | select(.class | test("(?i)chrom")) | .address' | tail -1)
      FOOT=$(hyprctl -j clients | jq -r '.[] | select(.class == "foot") | .address' | head -1)
      echo "CHROME=$CHROME FOOT=$FOOT"
      
      # 1. Current desktop
      timeout 8 grim "$OUT/catalog-01-desktop.png"
      
      # 2. Chrome maximized
      if [[ -n $CHROME ]]; then
        omarchy-shell window restore "$CHROME" || true
        omarchy-shell window maximize "$CHROME" || true
        sleep 0.5
        timeout 8 grim "$OUT/catalog-02-chrome-max.png"
        hyprctl -j clients | jq --arg a "$CHROME" '.[] | select(.address == $a) | {at,size,fullscreen,floating,hidden}'
      
        # 3. Chrome restored float
        omarchy-shell window unmaximize "$CHROME" || true
        sleep 0.5
        timeout 8 grim "$OUT/catalog-03-chrome-float.png"
        hyprctl -j clients | jq --arg a "$CHROME" '.[] | select(.address == $a) | {at,size,fullscreen,floating,hidden}'
      fi
      
      # 4. Start open
      omarchy-shell shell toggle omarchy.ultimate-start '{}' || true
      sleep 0.4
      timeout 8 grim "$OUT/catalog-04-start.png"
      
      # 5. Start closed
      omarchy-shell shell hide omarchy.ultimate-start || omarchy-shell shell toggle omarchy.ultimate-start '{}' || true
      sleep 0.4
      timeout 8 grim "$OUT/catalog-05-start-closed.png"
      
      # 6. Files if present, else launch
      FILES=$(hyprctl -j clients | jq -r '.[] | select(.class | test("(?i)nautilus|org.gnome.Nautilus")) | .address' | head -1)
      if [[ -z $FILES ]]; then
        gtk-launch org.gnome.Nautilus >/tmp/catalog-files.log 2>&1 || true
        sleep 1.5
        FILES=$(hyprctl -j clients | jq -r '.[] | select(.class | test("(?i)nautilus|org.gnome.Nautilus")) | .address' | head -1)
      fi
      echo "FILES=$FILES"
      if [[ -n $FILES ]]; then
        timeout 8 grim "$OUT/catalog-06-files.png"
        hyprctl -j clients | jq --arg a "$FILES" '.[] | select(.address == $a) | {class,at,size,fullscreen,floating,hidden}'
      fi
      
      # 7. Chrome minimized (taskbar only)
      if [[ -n $CHROME ]]; then
        omarchy-shell window minimize "$CHROME" || true
        sleep 0.4
        timeout 8 grim "$OUT/catalog-07-chrome-min.png"
        hyprctl -j clients | jq --arg a "$CHROME" '.[] | select(.address == $a) | {at,size,fullscreen,hidden}'
        omarchy-shell window restore "$CHROME" || true
        sleep 0.3
      fi
      
      ls -l "$OUT"/catalog-*.png
      echo CATALOG_SHOTS_DONE

      #!/bin/bash

        export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-1
      fi
      
      echo "=== MONITORS RAW ==="
      hyprctl monitors -j | jq '.'
      
      echo "=== CM OPTIONS ==="
      hyprctl getoption render:cm_auto_hdr -j 2>/dev/null || true
      hyprctl getoption render:cm_fs_passthrough -j 2>/dev/null || true
      hyprctl getoption render:cm_sdr_eotf -j 2>/dev/null || true
      hyprctl getoption decoration:screen_shader -j 2>/dev/null || true
      hyprctl getoption decoration:blur:enabled -j 2>/dev/null || true
      hyprctl getoption decoration:blur:vibrancy -j 2>/dev/null || true
      
      echo "=== HYPRSUNSET ==="
      pgrep -a hyprsunset || echo NO_HYPRSUNSET
      timeout 3 hyprctl hyprsunset temperature 2>/dev/null || echo NO_TEMP
      cat /home/jesse/.config/hypr/hyprsunset.conf 2>/dev/null || true
      
      echo "=== WALLPAPER ==="
      readlink -f /home/jesse/.local/state/omarchy/current/background || true
      ls -l /home/jesse/.local/state/omarchy/current/background || true
      BG=$(readlink -f /home/jesse/.local/state/omarchy/current/background || true)
      echo "BG=$BG"
      if [[ -f $BG ]]; then
        file "$BG" || true
        identify -verbose "$BG" 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'geometry|colorspace|profile|gamma|quality|type|depth|exif|icc' | head -40 || true
      fi
      
      echo "=== THEME ==="
      readlink -f /home/jesse/.config/omarchy/current/theme 2>/dev/null || true
      cat /home/jesse/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme 2>/dev/null || true
      ls /home/jesse/.config/omarchy/current/theme 2>/dev/null | head || true
      
      echo "=== CHROME CLIENTS ==="
      hyprctl -j clients | jq '[.[] | select(.class | test("(?i)chrom|google-chrome")) | {class,title,at,size,fullscreen,floating,hidden,xwayland}]'
      
      echo "=== PACKAGES ==="
      pacman -Q chromium google-chrome google-chrome-stable 2>/dev/null || true
      command -v google-chrome-stable || echo NO_GOOGLE_CHROME
      command -v chromium || true
      
      echo "=== NVIDIA ==="
      nvidia-smi -q -d CLOCK 2>/dev/null | head -5 || true
      cat /proc/driver/nvidia/gpus/*/information 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true

      function defaultFloatRect(monitor, options) {
        var area = workArea(monitor)
        var csd = !!(options && options.csd)
        var maxW = csd ? 1200 : 880
        var maxH = csd ? 740 : 560
        var minW = csd ? 1100 : 640
        var minH = csd ? 680 : 400
        var width = Math.min(maxW, Math.max(minW, Math.floor(area.width * (csd ? 0.64 : 0.46))))
        var height = Math.min(maxH, Math.max(minH, Math.floor(area.height * (csd ? 0.72 : 0.54))))

      #!/bin/bash
      set -euo pipefail
      export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000
      export HOME=/home/jesse
      export OMARCHY_PATH=/home/jesse/omarchy7ultimate
      cd "$OMARCHY_PATH"
      
      mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/state/omarchy/ultimate"
      cp -f "$OMARCHY_PATH/default/ultimate/taskbar-pins.json" "$HOME/.local/state/omarchy/ultimate/taskbar-pins.json"
      
      echo "=== CHROME ==="
      if ! pacman -Q google-chrome >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "installing google-chrome"
        omarchy-install-browser chrome || yay -S --noconfirm --needed google-chrome || echo CHROME_INSTALL_FAIL
      else
        echo "google-chrome already installed"
      fi
      pacman -Q google-chrome chromium 2>/dev/null || true
      ls /usr/share/applications/google-chrome.desktop /usr/share/icons/hicolor/*/apps/google-chrome.png 2>/dev/null | head
      
      echo "=== BUILD PLUGINS ==="
      make -C default/hypr/plugins/omarchy-minimize clean all
      make -C default/hypr/plugins/hyprbars clean all
      ls -l default/hypr/plugins/omarchy-minimize/omarchy-minimize.so default/hypr/plugins/hyprbars/hyprbars.so
      
      echo "=== RESTART HYPR ==="
      systemctl --user restart wayland-wm@hyprland.desktop.service || true
      sleep 8
      
      HIS=$(ls -1t /run/user/1000/hypr | head -1 || true)
      export HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE=$HIS
      if [[ -S $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/wayland-1 ]]; then
        export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-1
      fi
      while IFS= read -r line; do
        case $line in
          WAYLAND_DISPLAY=*|HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE=*|OMARCHY_PATH=*)
            export "$line"
            ;;
        esac
      done < <(systemctl --user show-environment)
      
      echo "HIS=$HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE WAYLAND=$WAYLAND_DISPLAY"
      pgrep -a Hyprland | head -3
      pgrep -a quickshell | head -3
      
      ok=0
      for _ in $(seq 1 12); do
        if timeout 3 hyprctl monitors -j >/tmp/hifi-mons.json 2>/dev/null; then
          ok=1
          break
        fi
        sleep 1
      done
      (( ok == 1 )) || echo HYPRCTL_DEAD
      timeout 5 hyprctl monitors -j | jq '[.[] | {name,width,height,refreshRate,scale,disabled,reserved}]'
      timeout 5 hyprctl getoption render:cm_auto_hdr -j || true
      timeout 5 hyprctl getoption decoration:blur:enabled -j || true
      timeout 5 hyprctl plugin list | head -20
      
      shell_ok=0
      for _ in $(seq 1 18); do
        if timeout 3 omarchy-shell shell ping 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok; then
          echo SHELL_OK
          shell_ok=1
          break
        fi
        sleep 1
      done
      (( shell_ok == 1 )) || echo SHELL_FAIL
      
      pkill -f 'minmax-foot' || true
      sleep 0.3
      
      client() {
        hyprctl -j clients | jq --arg a "$1" '.[] | select(.address == $a) | {class,title,at,size,fullscreen,hidden,floating}'
      }
      
      echo "=== LAUNCH FOOT ==="
      /usr/bin/foot -T minmax-foot >/tmp/minmax-foot.log 2>&1 &
      sleep 1.6
      FOOT=$(hyprctl -j clients | jq -r '.[] | select(.class == "foot" and (.title | test("minmax-foot"))) | .address' | head -1)
      echo "FOOT=$FOOT"
      client "$FOOT"
      
      echo "=== FOOT MAX/UNMAX/MIN/RESTORE ==="
      omarchy-shell window maximize "$FOOT"
      sleep 0.4
      client "$FOOT"
      omarchy-shell window unmaximize "$FOOT"
      sleep 0.4
      client "$FOOT"
      omarchy-shell window minimize "$FOOT"
      sleep 0.3
      client "$FOOT"
      omarchy-shell window restore "$FOOT"
      sleep 0.3
      client "$FOOT"
      
      echo "=== LAUNCH CHROME ==="
      if command -v google-chrome-stable >/dev/null; then
        gtk-launch google-chrome >/tmp/hifi-chrome.log 2>&1 || google-chrome-stable --new-window about:blank >/tmp/hifi-chrome.log 2>&1 &
      else
        gtk-launch chromium >/tmp/hifi-chrome.log 2>&1 || true
      fi
      sleep 2.2
      CHROME=$(hyprctl -j clients | jq -r '.[] | select(.class | test("(?i)chrom")) | .address' | tail -1)
      echo "CHROME=$CHROME"
      client "$CHROME"
      
      echo "=== CHROME MAX/UNMAX ==="
      omarchy-shell window maximize "$CHROME"
      sleep 0.4
      client "$CHROME"
      omarchy-shell window unmaximize "$CHROME"
      sleep 0.4
      client "$CHROME"
      
      OUT=/tmp/desktop-rescue
      mkdir -p "$OUT"
      rm -f "$OUT"/hifi-*.png "$OUT"/catalog-*.png
      
      timeout 8 grim "$OUT/hifi-01-desktop.png"
      timeout 8 grim "$OUT/hifi-02-chrome-float.png"
      
      omarchy-shell window maximize "$CHROME" || true
      sleep 0.4
      timeout 8 grim "$OUT/hifi-03-chrome-max.png"
      omarchy-shell window unmaximize "$CHROME" || true
      sleep 0.3
      
      omarchy-shell shell toggle omarchy.ultimate-start '{}' || true
      sleep 0.5
      timeout 8 grim "$OUT/hifi-04-start.png"
      omarchy-shell shell hide omarchy.ultimate-start || true
      sleep 0.3
      
      timeout 8 grim "$OUT/hifi-05-foot-chrome.png"
      
      # Bare wallpaper region: top-right, away from windows if possible
      if command -v magick >/dev/null; then
        timeout 8 grim "$OUT/hifi-06-full.png"
        magick "$OUT/hifi-06-full.png" -crop 240x180+1600+40 "$OUT/hifi-07-wp-crop.png"
        WP=$(readlink -f "$HOME/.local/state/omarchy/current/background" || true)
        echo "WP=$WP"
        if [[ -f $WP ]]; then
          magick "$WP" -resize 960x540 "$OUT/hifi-08-wp-file.png"
          magick "$WP" -crop 240x180+5000+400 "$OUT/hifi-09-wp-file-crop.png" || magick "$WP" -gravity NorthEast -crop 240x180+40+40 "$OUT/hifi-09-wp-file-crop.png"
          echo "FILE_CENTER=$(magick "$WP" -gravity Center -crop 1x1+0+0 -format '%[R],%[G],%[B]' info:)"
          echo "SCREEN_CROP=$(magick "$OUT/hifi-07-wp-crop.png" -resize 1x1! -format '%[R],%[G],%[B]' info:)"
        fi
      fi
      
      ls -l "$OUT"/hifi-*.png
      echo HIFI_PROVE_DONE

      # Hard-kill IPC waiters. Hyprland and quickshell stay up.
      kill -9 68272 68273 68274 68556 2>/dev/null || true
      sleep 0.2
      # Anything still wedged on hyprctl / emit-lua
      for pid in $(pgrep -f 'omarchy-hyprland-monitor-apply' || true); do
        kill -9 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
      done
      for pid in $(pgrep -x hyprctl || true); do
        kill -9 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
      done
      sleep 1
      echo "=== after kill ==="
      pgrep -a Hyprland || echo NO_HYPR
      pgrep -a quickshell || echo NO_QS
      pgrep -af monitor-apply || echo NO_APPLY
      pgrep -x hyprctl || echo NO_HYPRCTL
      export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000
      HIS=$(ls -1t /run/user/1000/hypr | head -1 || true)
      export HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE=$HIS
      export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-1
      echo HIS=$HIS
      timeout 2 hyprctl monitors -j | head -c 400 || echo HYPRCTL_STILL_DEAD
      echo KILL_DONE

  text:
    The desktop is back. Hyprland never crashed — IPC was deadlocked.
    
    `monitors.lua` runs `omarchy-hyprland-monitor-apply --emit-lua` while Hyprland is still loading config. That script called `hyprctl monitors`, which waits for Hyprland, which was waiting for the script. Two of those applies plus two `hyprctl` processes sat there until I SIGKILL’d the waiters. After that, `hyprctl` answered, the shell pinged `ok`, and grim shows the wallpaper and Superbar on HDMI-A-1 at 1920×1080@60.
    
    `--emit-lua` now reads DRM only and never calls `hyprctl`, so a reload cannot take the session down the same way. Locked in `d3412f9d`. I did not restart Hyprland again.

      export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000
      export HOME=/home/jesse
      export OMARCHY_PATH=/home/jesse/omarchy7ultimate
      export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-1
      HIS=$(ls -1t /run/user/1000/hypr | head -1 || true)
      export HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE=$HIS
      while IFS= read -r line; do
        case $line in
          WAYLAND_DISPLAY=*|HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE=*|OMARCHY_PATH=*)
            export "$line"
            ;;
        esac
      done < <(systemctl --user show-environment)
      
      cp -f "$OMARCHY_PATH/config/chrome-flags.conf" "$HOME/.config/chrome-flags.conf"
      cat >"$HOME/.local/share/applications/google-chrome.desktop" <<EOF
      [Desktop Entry]
      Version=1.0
      Name=Google Chrome
      Comment=Access the Internet
      Exec=$HOME/.local/opt/google/chrome/google-chrome --ozone-platform=wayland --enable-features=WaylandWindowDecorations %U
      Icon=google-chrome
      Type=Application
      Categories=Network;WebBrowser;
      StartupWMClass=Google-chrome
      MimeType=text/html;x-scheme-handler/http;x-scheme-handler/https;
      EOF
      
      echo "=== eval blur noise and opacity ==="
      timeout 3 hyprctl eval 'hl.config({ decoration = { blur = { noise = 0 } } })' || echo EVAL_BLUR_FAIL
      timeout 3 hyprctl eval 'o.window(".*", { opacity = "1 1" })' || echo EVAL_OPACITY_FAIL
      timeout 3 hyprctl getoption decoration:blur:noise -j || true
      
      echo "=== relaunch chrome with CSD flags ==="
      pkill -f '/home/jesse/.local/opt/google/chrome/chrome' || true
      sleep 1
      "$HOME/.local/opt/google/chrome/google-chrome" \
        --ozone-platform=wayland \
        --enable-features=WaylandWindowDecorations \
        --new-window about:blank >/tmp/caption-chrome2.log 2>&1 &
      sleep 2.8
      
      CHROME=$(timeout 3 hyprctl -j clients | jq -r '.[] | select(.class | test("(?i)chrom")) | .address' | tail -1)
      echo "CHROME=$CHROME"
      timeout 3 hyprctl -j clients | jq --arg a "$CHROME" '.[] | select(.address == $a) | {class,at,size,floating,xwayland,fullscreen}'
      echo "=== cmdline ==="
      pgrep -a '/home/jesse/.local/opt/google/chrome/chrome' | head -3 || pgrep -a chrome | head -3
      
      eval $(timeout 3 hyprctl -j clients | jq -r --arg a "$CHROME" '.[] | select(.address == $a) | "X=\(.at[0]); Y=\(.at[1]); W=\(.size[0]); H=\(.size[1])"')
      echo "geom ${X}x${Y} ${W}x${H}"
      mkdir -p /tmp/desktop-rescue
      timeout 8 grim /tmp/desktop-rescue/caption-10-full.png
      CX=$((X + W - 260))
      [ "$CX" -lt 0 ] && CX=0
      timeout 8 grim -g "${CX},${Y} 260x52" /tmp/desktop-rescue/caption-11-tr.png || true
      timeout 8 grim -g "${X},${Y} ${W}x56" /tmp/desktop-rescue/caption-12-bar.png || true
      ls -l /tmp/desktop-rescue/caption-1[012]-*.png
      echo CAPTION_LIVE_DONE

      export HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE=$HIS
      while IFS= read -r line; do
        case $line in
          WAYLAND_DISPLAY=*|HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE=*|OMARCHY_PATH=*)
            export "$line"
            ;;
        esac
      done < <(systemctl --user show-environment)
      
      echo "HIS=$HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE"
      pgrep -a Hyprland | head -2
      pgrep -a quickshell | head -2

      if [ ! -s /tmp/rb-mons.json ]; then
        echo GIVING_UP_NO_IPC
        exit 1
      fi
      
      ok=0
      i=0
      while [ "$i" -lt 15 ]; do
        i=$((i + 1))
        if timeout 3 omarchy-shell shell ping 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok; then
          echo SHELL_OK
          ok=1
          break
        fi
        sleep 1
      done
      [ "$ok" = 1 ]
      
      "$HOME/.local/opt/google/chrome/google-chrome" \
        --ozone-platform=wayland \
        --disable-features=WaylandWindowDecorations \
        --new-window about:blank >/tmp/chrome-vis.log 2>&1 &
      sleep 2.6
      
      CHROME=$(timeout 3 hyprctl -j clients | jq -r '.[] | select(.class | test("(?i)chrom")) | .address' | tail -1)
      echo "CHROME=$CHROME"
      timeout 3 hyprctl -j clients | jq --arg a "$CHROME" '.[] | select(.address == $a) | {class,at,size,floating}'
      
      eval $(timeout 3 hyprctl -j clients | jq -r --arg a "$CHROME" '.[] | select(.address == $a) | "X=\(.at[0]); Y=\(.at[1]); W=\(.size[0]); H=\(.size[1])"')
      echo "geom ${X}x${Y} ${W}x${H}"
      mkdir -p /tmp/desktop-rescue

      CX=$((X + W - 200))
      [ "$CX" -lt 0 ] && CX=0
      timeout 8 grim -g "${CX},${Y} 200x40" /tmp/desktop-rescue/caption-31-buttons.png
      timeout 8 grim -g "${X},${Y} ${W}x40" /tmp/desktop-rescue/caption-32-title.png
      ls -l /tmp/desktop-rescue/caption-3[012]-*.png
      echo VISIBLE_BUTTONS_DONE

  text:
    Chrome’s own caption cannot show min/max on this compositor. Hyprland marks the window maximized on first map so Chromium CSD hides those buttons and leaves a single close flush on the right. Making the window 1200×740 and turning on `WaylandWindowDecorations` does not undo that. Desktop Mode now draws the caption with hyprbars: light **min / max** rectangles and a red **close**, and Chrome is launched with Wayland CSD off so those are the only window buttons.
    
    The grain was compositor blur noise (0.0117) plus 0.985 window opacity letting the wallpaper bleed through. Noise is 0 and Desktop Mode windows are opaque. The winding-road still reads purple because that JPEG is already graded that way; that is the file, not a second live filter.

      // Hyprland's xdg ctor queues TILED_LEFT/RIGHT/TOP/BOTTOM plus a fake
      // MAXIMIZED so SSD clients hide CSD. Chrome caches that first configure and
      // then paints the fused tab strip with only ×. A second wm_capabilities
      // without xdg_surface.configure is ignored. Strip the lie and configure.
      static void stripTiledAndMaximized(SP<CXDGToplevelResource> top) {
        if (!top)
          return;
        auto& states = top->m_pendingApply.states;
        states.erase(std::remove_if(states.begin(), states.end(),

                                             s == XDG_TOPLEVEL_STATE_TILED_TOP || s == XDG_TOPLEVEL_STATE_TILED_BOTTOM ||
                                             s == XDG_TOPLEVEL_STATE_MAXIMIZED;
                                    }),
                     states.end());
      }
      
      static bool userMaximizedCsd(PHLWINDOW w) {
        if (!w)
          return false;
        const auto key = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(w.get());
        return g_savedFloat.contains(key) && isMaximizedNow(w);
      }
      
      static void restoreCsdCaption(PHLWINDOW w) {
        if (!w)
          return;
        advertiseWmCapabilities(w);
        auto xdg = w->m_xdgSurface.lock();
        if (!xdg)
          return;
        auto top = xdg->m_toplevel.lock();
        if (!top)
          return;
        if (!userMaximizedCsd(w)) {
          stripTiledAndMaximized(top);
          top->setMaximized(false);
          w->m_suppressNextMaximize = true;
        }
        xdg->scheduleConfigure();

      from pathlib import Path
      import struct, zlib
      
      def load(path):
          data = Path(path).read_bytes()
          pos = 8
          w = h = None
          raw = b''
          bitdepth = colortype = 8
          while pos < len(data):
              ln = struct.unpack('>I', data[pos:pos+4])[0]
              typ = data[pos+4:pos+8]
              chunk = data[pos+8:pos+8+ln]
              pos += 12 + ln
              if typ == b'IHDR':
                  w, h, bitdepth, colortype = struct.unpack('>IIBB', chunk[:10])
              elif typ == b'IDAT':
                  raw += chunk
              elif typ == b'IEND':
                  break
          rows = zlib.decompress(raw)
          if colortype == 2:
              bpp = 3
          elif colortype == 6:
              bpp = 4
          else:
              raise SystemExit(f'unsupported color {colortype}')
          pix = bytearray()
          stride = 1 + w * bpp
          for y in range(h):
              pix.extend(rows[y*stride+1:(y+1)*stride])
          return w, h, bpp, bytes(pix)
      
      def row_stats(pix, w, h, bpp, y):
          rs=gs=bs=0
          red=0
          whites=0
          for x in range(w):
              i = (y*w+x)*bpp
              r,g,b = pix[i], pix[i+1], pix[i+2]
              rs+=r; gs+=g; bs+=b
              if r>160 and g<80 and b<80:
                  red += 1
              if r>200 and g>200 and b>200:
                  whites += 1
          n=max(w,1)
          return (rs//n, gs//n, bs//n, red, whites)

          for y in range(0, h, max(1, h//12)):
              avg=row_stats(pix,w,h,bpp,y)

      // that first event and never draws tab-strip min/max/close. Patch the
      // one-instruction default so the first configure is CLIENT_SIDE.
      static void patchXdgDefaultModeCsd() {
        auto* fn = static_cast<uint8_t*>(dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "_ZN14CXDGDecoration17xdgDefaultModeCSDEv"));
        if (!fn)
          return;
        const long page = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);
        if (page <= 0)
          return;

        if (mprotect(pageAddr, static_cast<size_t>(page) * 2, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE | PROT_EXEC) != 0)
          return;

        fn[1] = 0x01;
        fn[2] = 0x00;

      set -euo pipefail
      python3 - <<'PY'
      from pathlib import Path
      import struct, zlib
      
      def load(path):
          data = Path(path).read_bytes()
          pos = 8
          w = h = None
          raw = b''
          colortype = 2
          while pos < len(data):
              ln = struct.unpack('>I', data[pos:pos+4])[0]
              typ = data[pos+4:pos+8]
              chunk = data[pos+8:pos+8+ln]
              pos += 12 + ln
              if typ == b'IHDR':
                  w, h = struct.unpack('>II', chunk[:8])
                  colortype = chunk[9]
              elif typ == b'IDAT':
                  raw += chunk
              elif typ == b'IEND':
                  break
          rows = zlib.decompress(raw)
          bpp = 4 if colortype == 6 else 3
          pix = bytearray()
          stride = 1 + w * bpp
          for y in range(h):
              pix.extend(rows[y*stride+1:(y+1)*stride])
          return w, h, bpp, bytes(pix)
      
      w,h,bpp,pix=load('/tmp/desktop-rescue/csd-full.png')
      # window at 360,146 1200x740 per last prove
      ox,oy,ow,oh=360,146,1200,740
      print(f'full {w}x{h} window {ox},{oy} {ow}x{oh}')
      print('row avgs:')
      for yoff in range(0, 48):
          y=oy+yoff
          rs=gs=bs=0
          red=white=light=0
          for x in range(ox, ox+ow):
              i=(y*w+x)*bpp
              r,g,b=pix[i],pix[i+1],pix[i+2]
              rs+=r; gs+=g; bs+=b
              if r>160 and g<90 and b<90: red+=1
              if r>200 and g>200 and b>200: white+=1
              if r+g+b>360: light+=1
          n=ow
          print(f'  y={yoff:2d} avg=({rs//n:3d},{gs//n:3d},{bs//n:3d}) red={red:4d} white={white:4d} light={light:4d}')
      
      # right 200 x top 40: column brightness to find 3 buttons
      print('right-200 column brightness (sum over y=0..36):')
      left=ox+ow-200
      col=[0]*200
      for yoff in range(0,36):
          y=oy+yoff
          for dx in range(200):
              i=(y*w+(left+dx))*bpp
              col[dx]+=pix[i]+pix[i+1]+pix[i+2]
      # find peaks
      for dx in range(200):
          if col[dx] > 36*200:
              print(f'  x+{dx} sum={col[dx]}')
      
      print('right crop contrast map y=0..40 x=right200, cells > bg+40:')
      # local bg
      for yoff in range(0,40):
          y=oy+yoff
          marks=[]
          for dx in range(200):
              i=(y*w+(left+dx))*bpp
              r,g,b=pix[i],pix[i+1],pix[i+2]
              if r+g+b>200:
                  marks.append(dx)
          if marks:
              # compress to ranges
              ranges=[]
              s=marks[0]; p=marks[0]
              for m in marks[1:]:
                  if m<=p+2:
                      p=m
                  else:
                      ranges.append((s,p))
                      s=p=m
              ranges.append((s,p))
              print(f'  y={yoff:2d} {ranges}')
      PY

      #!/bin/bash
      python3 - <<'PY'
      from pathlib import Path
      import struct, zlib
      
      def load(path):
          data = Path(path).read_bytes()
          pos = 8
          w = h = None
          raw = b''
          colortype = 2
          while pos < len(data):
              ln = struct.unpack('>I', data[pos:pos+4])[0]
              typ = data[pos+4:pos+8]
              chunk = data[pos+8:pos+8+ln]
              pos += 12 + ln
              if typ == b'IHDR':
                  w, h = struct.unpack('>II', chunk[:8])
                  colortype = chunk[9]
              elif typ == b'IDAT':
                  raw += chunk
              elif typ == b'IEND':
                  break
          rows = zlib.decompress(raw)
          bpp = 4 if colortype == 6 else 3
          pix = bytearray()
          stride = 1 + w * bpp
          for y in range(h):
              pix.extend(rows[y*stride+1:(y+1)*stride])
          return w, h, bpp, bytes(pix)
      
      w,h,bpp,pix=load('/tmp/desktop-rescue/csd-full.png')
      ox,oy,ow=360,146,1200
      print(f'full {w}x{h}')
      print('right 280 of window, light ranges:')
      left=ox+ow-280
      for yoff in range(0, 50):
          y=oy+yoff
          marks=[]
          for dx in range(280):
              i=(y*w+(left+dx))*bpp
              r,g,b=pix[i],pix[i+1],pix[i+2]
              if r+g+b>220:
                  marks.append(dx)
          if not marks:
              continue
          ranges=[]
          s=p=marks[0]
          for m in marks[1:]:
              if m<=p+3:
                  p=m
              else:
                  if p-s>=3:
                      ranges.append((s,p,p-s+1))
                  s=p=m
          if p-s>=3:
              ranges.append((s,p,p-s+1))
          if ranges:
              print(f'  y={yoff:2d} {ranges}')
      
      # also dump csd-tr dimensions and right-side
      wt,ht,bppt,pixt=load('/tmp/desktop-rescue/csd-tr.png')
      print(f'tr {wt}x{ht}')
      for y in range(ht):
          marks=[]
          for x in range(wt):
              i=(y*wt+x)*bppt
              r,g,b=pixt[i],pixt[i+1],pixt[i+2]
              if r+g+b>220:
                  marks.append(x)
          if not marks:
              continue
          ranges=[]
          s=p=marks[0]
          for m in marks[1:]:
              if m<=p+3:
                  p=m
              else:
                  if p-s>=2:
                      ranges.append((s,p))
                  s=p=m
          if p-s>=2:
              ranges.append((s,p))
          if ranges:
              print(f'  tr y={y:2d} {ranges}')
      PY
      echo PROOF3_DONE

      static void patchXdgDefaultModeCsd() {
        auto* fn = static_cast<uint8_t*>(dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "_ZN14CXDGDecoration17xdgDefaultModeCSDEv"));
        if (!fn)
          return;
        const long page = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);
        if (page <= 0)
          return;
        auto* pageAddr = reinterpret_cast<void*>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(fn) & ~static_cast<uintptr_t>(page - 1));
        if (mprotect(pageAddr, static_cast<size_t>(page) * 2, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE | PROT_EXEC) != 0)
          return;
        fn[0] = 0xb8;
        fn[1] = 0x01;
        fn[2] = 0x00;
        fn[3] = 0x00;
        fn[4] = 0x00;
        fn[5] = 0xc3;
      }

    You were right. Those three buttons belong on Chrome’s own caption row, and they were never impossible. Adding a second hyprbars row was the wrong fix. That’s gone.
    
    What actually deleted them:
    
    1. **GNOME `button-layout` was `appmenu:close`.** Chrome/Linux reads that and only draws close. Min and max were deleted in GTK, not in Chrome.
    2. **Hyprland advertises xdg-decoration and answers SERVER_SIDE.** Chrome then waits for a compositor title bar. `hyprbars:no_bar` hides that bar. Result: empty tab-strip trailing edge.
    3. **`--disable-features=WaylandWindowDecorations`** (the last “fix”) turned CSD off so hyprbars could draw a second row. That’s the dual chrome you saw.
    
    What’s live now:
    
    - Chrome is back on the CSD list. Wayland CSD is on. `hyprctl decorations` for Chrome is `none` — no hyprbars row.
    - Button layout is `:minimize,maximize,close`. Pixel grim of the Chrome window top-right shows three caption clusters on Chrome’s own chrome, not a second bar.
    - Maximize still works: `1200×740` → `1920×1032` → restore `1200×740`. `{changed:true}`.
    - Locked in `ccbe472f`: CSD list, flags, decoration-global hide, first-run + migration off `appmenu:close`. Tests reject `disable-features=WaylandWindowDecorations` and reject Chrome leaving the CSD list.
    
    This is the caption row. It is not whole-product W0. Superbar/Start still have uncommitted hi-fi work, and the wallpaper file is still that magenta-graded Tokyo Night shot.

      echo "=== ping ==="
      timeout 4 omarchy-shell shell ping 2>/dev/null || echo PING_FAIL
      echo "=== monitors ==="

      timeout 5 hyprctl plugin list || true
      HPID=$(pgrep -n Hyprland || true)
      echo "Hyprland=$HPID"
      if [[ -n $HPID ]]; then
        echo "=== plugin maps ==="
        awk '{print $6}' /proc/$HPID/maps | sort -u | grep -E 'hyprbars|omarchy-minimize' || true
      fi
      echo "=== button-layout ==="
      gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.wm.preferences button-layout || true
      grep -E 'gtk-decoration-layout' ~/.config/gtk-3.0/settings.ini || true
      echo "=== chrome flags live ==="
      if [[ -x $HOME/.local/opt/google/chrome/google-chrome ]]; then

        cat ~/.config/chrome-flags.conf 2>/dev/null || echo NO_USER_CHROME_FLAGS

      fi
      echo "=== clients ==="
      timeout 5 hyprctl -j clients | jq -c '.[] | {class,title,at,size,address,fullscreen,floating,xwayland,hidden}'
      echo "=== layers ==="
      timeout 5 hyprctl -j layers | jq -c '.. | objects | select(.namespace != null) | {namespace,w,h,x,y}' 2>/dev/null || timeout 5 hyprctl layers | head -60
      echo "=== decorations chrome/files/foot ==="

      done

      #!/bin/bash
      set -euo pipefail
      export HOME=/home/jesse
      export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000
      export OMARCHY_PATH=/home/jesse/omarchy7ultimate
      export PATH="$OMARCHY_PATH/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
      while IFS= read -r line; do
        case $line in
          WAYLAND_DISPLAY=*|HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE=*|OMARCHY_PATH=*)
            export "$line"
            ;;
        esac
      done < <(systemctl --user show-environment 2>/dev/null || true)
      if [[ -z ${HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE:-} && -d /run/user/1000/hypr ]]; then
        export HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE=$(ls -1t /run/user/1000/hypr | head -1 || true)
      fi
      if [[ -z ${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-} ]]; then
        if [[ -S $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/wayland-1 ]]; then
          export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-1
        elif [[ -S $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/wayland-0 ]]; then
          export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-0
        fi
      fi
      
      OUT=/tmp/desktop-rescue
      mkdir -p "$OUT"
      FAILS=0
      note() { echo "$*"; }
      fail() { echo "FAIL: $*"; FAILS=$((FAILS + 1)); }
      pass() { echo "PASS: $*"; }
      
      client_json() {
        hyprctl -j clients | jq --arg a "$1" '.[] | select(.address == $a)'
      }
      
      find_addr() {
        local pat=$1
        hyprctl -j clients | jq -r --arg p "$pat" '.[] | select(.class | test($p; "i")) | .address' | tail -1
      }
      
      wait_addr() {
        local pat=$1
        local deadline=$((SECONDS + 12))
        local a=""
        while ((SECONDS < deadline)); do
          a=$(find_addr "$pat")
          if [[ -n $a ]]; then
            echo "$a"
            return 0
          fi
          sleep 0.25
        done
        return 1
      }
      
      echo "=== W0 prove start $(date) ==="
      echo "HIS=$HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE WAYLAND=$WAYLAND_DISPLAY"
      
      timeout 5 hyprctl -j monitors | jq -e '.[0].width==1920 and .[0].height==1080 and (. [0].refreshRate|floor)==60' >/dev/null \
        && pass "HDMI 1920x1080@60" \
        || fail "monitor is not 1920x1080@60: $(timeout 5 hyprctl -j monitors | jq '[.[]|{name,width,height,refreshRate}]')"
      
      timeout 3 omarchy-shell shell ping 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok && pass "shell ping" || fail "shell ping"
      
      BL=$(gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.wm.preferences button-layout || true)
      [[ $BL == *minimize* && $BL == *maximize* && $BL == *close* ]] && pass "gsettings button-layout $BL" || fail "button-layout $BL"
      
      # --- Chrome already running or launch ---
      CHROME=$(find_addr 'chrom')
      if [[ -z $CHROME ]]; then
        if [[ -x $HOME/.local/opt/google/chrome/google-chrome ]]; then
          "$HOME/.local/opt/google/chrome/google-chrome" --ozone-platform=wayland --enable-features=WaylandWindowDecorations --new-window about:blank >/tmp/w0-chrome.log 2>&1 &
        else
          gtk-launch chromium >/tmp/w0-chrome.log 2>&1 || true
        fi
        CHROME=$(wait_addr 'chrom' || true)
      fi
      echo "CHROME=$CHROME"
      [[ -n $CHROME ]] || fail "chrome did not map"
      if [[ -n $CHROME ]]; then
        hyprctl decorations "$CHROME" 2>&1 | grep -qi '^none$' && pass "chrome decorations none" || fail "chrome decorations: $(hyprctl decorations "$CHROME" 2>&1 | head -5)"
        client_json "$CHROME" | jq -c '{class,title,at,size,fullscreen,floating,xwayland}'
        CMDLINE=$(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$(hyprctl -j clients | jq -r --arg a "$CHROME" '.[]|select(.address==$a)|.pid')/cmdline)
        echo "CHROME_CMDLINE=$CMDLINE"
        echo "$CMDLINE" | grep -q 'disable-features=WaylandWindowDecorations' && fail "chrome still disables WaylandWindowDecorations" || pass "chrome cmdline has no disable WaylandWindowDecorations"
        echo "$CMDLINE" | grep -q 'WaylandWindowDecorations' && pass "chrome cmdline enables WaylandWindowDecorations" || fail "chrome cmdline missing WaylandWindowDecorations"
      
        # Re-query at immediately before grim
        sleep 0.2
        read -r CX CY CW CH < <(hyprctl -j clients | jq -r --arg a "$CHROME" '.[]|select(.address==$a)| "\(.at[0]) \(.at[1]) \(.size[0]) \(.size[1])"')
        echo "CHROME_GEOM=$CX,$CY ${CW}x${CH}"
